sub_indicators.label: Internet in secondary schools
sub_indicators.subject: capacity.training
sub_indicators.text: DT-related training in secondary education: internet in secondary schools
sub_indicators.norm_short: The AU Digital Education Strategy asks for half of institutions connected by 2027 and a digital literacy and coding framework for all students.
criteria: The latest figure, for 2023 or later, puts secondary schools with internet for teaching below 17 per cent.
17 per cent or more of secondary schools have internet for teaching, in the latest figure for 2023 or later, from UNESCO's SDG 4.a.1 series.
33 per cent or more of secondary schools have internet for teaching.
50 per cent or more of secondary schools have internet for teaching.
50 per cent or more of secondary schools have internet for teaching, and digital literacy or computing is a compulsory subject in the national secondary curriculum.

aspects.name: Secondary schools with internet for teaching
